item.title: Virginia Attorney General enforces new social media restrictions for minors
item.description: Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones is pledging to use his office to enforce the Commonwealth's new social media restrictions on children under the age of 16.

item.title: CCPS Mini-Museum unveiled with tiny ribbon-cutting celebration
item.description: A ribbon-cutting was held for the CCPS Mini-Museum, a display featuring bite-sized recreations of school buildings, classrooms, and real museums — all created by students across every CCPS school.

item.title: Cinderella Dreams gives free prom attire to Virginia teens in need
item.description: For 20 years, Cinderella Dreams has been giving teenagers who need a helping hand the tools to make prom night special.
